precondition: The project MCP server bbdev is loaded and the Ball, its ISA macro and its CTest exist in the checkout

inputs.name: ball
inputs.description: Ball name whose workload directory holds the CTest

inputs.name: chip
inputs.description: Chip configuration the workload is built against

inputs.name: platform
inputs.description: Binary platform suffix, baremetal unless the test is a toolchain test

outputs.name: bemu-log
outputs.description: BEMU run log for the built binary

outputs.name: rtl-report
outputs.description: Verilator RTL report for the same binary and config
